changelog:
- Initial release of the voice-call skill.
- Enables starting and inspecting voice calls using the OpenClaw voice-call plugin (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, or mock provider).
- CLI commands to initiate and check status of calls.
- Exposes actions for agents: initiate, continue, speak, end, and get status of calls.
- Requires plugin to be enabled and properly configured for your chosen provider.
summary: Start voice calls via the OpenClaw voice-call plugin.
